input.prompt:
Create a production game sprite sheet of six completely original Daoist Q-style torso garment inventory icons for 灵葫大作战. Exactly SIX individual waist-up clothing items in the 3-column × 2-row layout of the first reference. Native 1536×1024, invisible square cells 512px, centers (256,256), (768,256), (1280,256), (256,768), (768,768), (1280,768). Each garment completely isolated, width around 365px and strictly no larger than 392px, height around 195–258px, at least 56px transparent clear air all around each cell's boundary. Every garment is viewed straight-on like a floating torso tunic with a hollow collar, two short sleeves or shoulder pads, center chest and solid waist or segmented armor hem. No head, hair, helmet, neck skin, arms, hands, legs, footwear, mannequin, weapons, body, hanger, unrelated trinket, character, lettering, checkerboard, borders, panels, shadow, room, or glow. True transparency in all negative space. Exactly six wide squat separate cutouts without clips.

Reference one is the six actual inventory thumbnails; use only silhouette role, order, shoulder/collar/waist structure and relative color grouping. Absolutely omit the blue frames, backing, glow and person skin. Do not trace. The next two supplied references are our canonical game's Daoist Q visuals. Draw warm hand-painted enamel, satin silk, carved lacquer, bronze, jade, thick crisp rounded contour with confident color separation, coherent top-left light and carefully sized details. Make each distinct through oversized simple features and identifiable at 32px on deep jade and pale parchment. Absolutely NO shared plate, labels or drop shadows.

Top-left, 1194 CLOUD COURT COAT: wide upward orange-cinnabar robe shoulders with thick golden curling cloud seam, orange standing collar and three red/orange chest ridges, dark navy sleeve inner edges, broad indigo curved waist panel with a jade blue/gold belt hem. Gold and red dominant, sparse jade inset. Top-right, 1196 WIND ARENA VEST: short flat athletic torso, blue-celadon short shoulder pads with broad white curls, dark midnight teal undercloth, pale cyan shield-like chest inset and three thick horizontal cobalt belt ribbons. Compact wide and relatively shallow, less ornate and more cloth than its siblings.

Bottom-left, 1197 GOLDEN CLOUD GUARD ARMOR: broad scalloped cream-gold shoulders with three short angled carved segments, orange chest, moss jade-green wide waist bib with a single embossed ruyi spiral and antique gold bound edge. Strong jade waist area anchors it visibly apart from the dragon armor. Bottom-middle, 1453 SUN TALISMAN MAIL: ochre-gold and warm brass tiered compact heavy armor, large rounded gold pauldron blocks, square central sun-talisman chest boss in polished honey enamel (no glyphs), two bright rectangular hip plates along the hem. Warm shaded burnt-sienna seams, no outline glow. Bottom-right, 1460 INK THUNDER MAIL: nearly same squat armor family as Sun but original blue-black indigo iron cuirass, two chunky midnight shoulder caps and two squared segmented hip plates, steel blue reflective bevel and small powder-blue sternum diamond (no lightning outside the object), sapphire undercloth. Use medium-light blue highlights so ink armor still reads against deep jade at 32px. This armor is distinctly cool, dark, and matte.

Final output: exactly six true-alpha game inventory sprite icons, no text, neat 3×2, clear blank margins.
